sections.heading: Welcome aboard Ventura
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger companion. Venue details are a planning reference, not live ship information. Always follow onboard signage, announcements and crew instructions.

sections.heading: Decks and finding your way
sections.body: Ventura deck names: P (5), F (6), Prom (7), E (8), D (9), C (10), B (11), A (12), Riviera (14), Lido (15), Sun (16), Sports (17), Sky (18) and Ocean (19). G Deck also appears on the official plan. Use your saved cabin and deck notes to remember lift banks and routes. Official P&O Ventura 2026–27 deck plan (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/content/dam/po/inventory-assets/ships/VE/Ventura-Deck-Plan-W26-27.pdf

sections.heading: Dining: included options
sections.body: P&O lists three main dining venues (Bay Tree, Saffron and Cinnamon), Waterside buffet and poolside pizzeria and grill. Main dining arrangements may be Club or Freedom Dining, depending on booking. Check your cruise details and onboard information for the arrangement assigned to you.

sections.heading: Dining: speciality options
sections.body: P&O lists Epicurean (modern British dining), Sindhu (Indian-British fusion), The Beach House (Latin American and Caribbean-inspired dishes) and The Glass House (wine and tapas-style dishes). Supplements or reservations may apply. Confirm menus, prices and availability onboard.

sections.heading: Bars and coffee
sections.body: Options listed by P&O include Red Bar for cocktails and champagne, Metropolis, The Exchange pub-style bar, Tazzine for coffee, and bars in entertainment venues. Drinks packages and individual prices depend on your booking and current terms.

sections.heading: Evening entertainment
sections.body: The Arena Theatre hosts stage shows; Havana and The Tamarind Club host live music, comedy and other entertainment. The Exchange may also feature entertainment. Shows and times vary by cruise: check Horizon or the onboard programme.

sections.heading: Pools, wellness and families
sections.body: P&O describes four swimming pools, sports activities, a video game arcade, spa facilities and family activities on Ventura. Check current availability, safety guidance, age limits and any charges.

sections.heading: Embarkation checklist
sections.body: Check boarding time and terminal instructions in your official cruise documents. Keep required travel documents and essential medication in hand luggage. Follow muster and safety instructions from crew.

sections.heading: Sea-day ideas
sections.body: Review the daily Horizon programme, add preferred shows and reservations to My Cruise, and use My Day for a quick personal overview. The app does not automatically import the ship schedule.

sections.heading: Going ashore safely
sections.body: Check the official all-aboard time and ship local time before leaving. Bring required documents and allow time to return. Ports and timings can change; crew announcements take priority.

sections.heading: Onboard spending and drinks
sections.body: The Spending and Drinks sections are personal trackers only, not linked to your onboard account. Always verify your onboard statement and current drinks package terms with P&O.

sections.heading: Official sources and independence
sections.body: P&O Ventura overview: https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/ventura/overview ; dining: https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/ventura/dining ; entertainment: https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/ventura/entertainment ; drinks: https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/ventura/drinks . This independent guide is not endorsed by P&O Cruises.
